item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 07/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the northeast monsoon moderating, winds will be weak and the visibility will be relatively low over Guangdong in the next few days. It will be rather warm during the day. A cold front is expected to move across the coastal areas early next week, it will become cool and windier over the region. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over Guangdong midweek next week.
